blocks.text: Miss Universe Jamaica 2025 Gabrielle Henry filed a negligence lawsuit against Miss Universe Organization (MUO) over her 2025 fall from the pageant stage, which caused her severe head injuries. Henry lodged the case against MUO and its parent companies, JKN Legacy Inc. and Legacy Holding Group USA, on Monday, Sept. 21 in Delaware Superior Court. According to the copy of the complaint obtained by PEOPLE, the beauty queen alleged negligence, premises liability, negligent hiring, retention and supervision, as well as negligent and intentional infliction of emotional distress.
